name: Export Orders & Emailed Reports for WooCommerce
author: crownbean

sections.description:
WooCommerce Export Orders & Email Reports (Automated Daily Reports) helps store owners easily export WooCommerce order data, generate reports, and automate daily or weekly email delivery of sales summaries — all without complex setup or external services.

The plugin is designed for store managers, accountants, and teams who need clean, filtered WooCommerce reports for sales, fulfillment, or analysis.

Key Features (Free Version)

  • Export WooCommerce orders to CSV format instantly.
  • Filter exports by date range, order status, or customer.
  • Choose which order fields to include in your export.
  • One-click export directly from the WooCommerce admin area.
  • Simple, lightweight, and compatible with all major WooCommerce themes and extensions.

Upgrade to Pro

The Pro version unlocks powerful automation and reporting features:
– Schedule daily, weekly, or monthly automated exports.
– Automatically email order or sales reports to your entire team.
– Export in multiple formats — XLSX, JSON, or CSV.
– Built-in standalone email delivery system — no SMTP setup required.
– Advanced filtering (by product, category, customer type, etc.).
– Dedicated “Schedules” dashboard for managing reports easily.

The free version of Export Orders & Automated Daily Reports includes all core export functionality.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/crownbean-export-orders-for-woocommerce/, or install via Plugins → Add New from the dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Export Orders to start exporting or managing scheduled reports.
sections.faq:
Do I need to set up anything before exporting orders?

No setup required. Once activated, an Export Orders page automatically appears under your WooCommerce admin menu. From there, you can export orders instantly.

Can I schedule WooCommerce exports or automated email reports?

Yes — this feature is available in the Pro version. You can create daily, weekly, or monthly scheduled exports, filtered by date, customer, or order status, and have the reports emailed automatically to one or multiple recipients. All schedules can be managed from the dedicated Schedules page.

Can I export WooCommerce orders to Excel (XLSX) or JSON?

Absolutely. The Pro version supports exporting orders to Excel (XLSX) and JSON formats for easier analysis and third-party integrations.

Will this plugin modify my WooCommerce orders or database?

No. The plugin only reads WooCommerce order data for export. It does not alter, delete, or write any data to your store database.

Can I send daily sales or order reports to my team automatically?

Yes, in the Pro version you can email daily, weekly, or monthly order reports directly to your team or clients — perfect for sales tracking, accounting, or fulfillment updates.

Does it work with large stores or many orders?

Yes. The export engine is optimized for performance and supports stores with thousands of orders. You can also use filters to export smaller, targeted reports if needed.
